title: Recover Boolean cubic counts from the same residue at degree three
statement: At fixed F8[t]/t^2, the same J_r residue with arbitrary higher cubic coefficients and no quotient noise is #P-hard. For an even N>=2 source Boolean cubic, n=12N+18 original target bits and the explicit affine ring-count formula recover its signed count.

requires: Actual fixed d=3,e=2 construction and arbitrary higher nilpotent coefficients
Even N>=2, or explicit unused-input padding with its known factor
provides: At fixed F8[t]/t^2, the same J_r residue with arbitrary higher cubic coefficients and no quotient noise is #P-hard. For an even N>=2 source Boolean cubic, n=12N+18 original target bits and the explicit affine ring-count formula recover its signed count.
assumptions: This is outside the all-depth theorem's3-not-dividing-d promise
The displayed F8 radial factor is not silently reused for even extension degrees
costs: Polynomial description expansion, original n=12N+18 bits and O(n)-bit exact arithmetic
Circuit-to-cubic hardness arithmetization charges introduced wire/multiplier variables and its2^equations factor
contract.units: Original independent Boolean bits; F_(2^d) elements and ordinary field/ring exponents are distinct from Boolean ANF masks. Exact signed/zero counts and source-local phase/rank/depth units.
contract.obstruction: A chain-field relabeling does not remove the d=3 obstruction; erasing nilpotent data can erase the encoded source cubic.

body: With s0=(-1)^p(0), Ncrit=2^(N-1)(2^N+1) and source signed count Zp, the signed ring count is8^(2N+3)[1+3*Ncrit+4*2^(N-1)(Zp+s0)]. The archived42/66-bit raw acquisitions are not full ring truth-table enumerations.

evidence.quote: \subsection{A sharp divisibility boundary in the same residue family}
evidence.range_scope: Exact governing construction and its conditions; archived source bytes remain authoritative.

evidence.quote: Thus #P-hardness holds inside this exact J_r residue family
evidence.range_scope: Completed independent same-J-residue hardness audit, including exact multiplicities and source-count recovery; fixed d=3,e=2 scope.

review.scope: Actual completed archived internal audits at the stated proof/interface; no scientific-program replay or practical-speed claim by intake.
